programmes.d: Scientists discover time travel with horrible consequences when they inadvertently bring a giant carnivorous dinosaur back to modern Los Angeles.

Based on the Science Fiction adventure, survivors of an American military vessel sunk by a Russian sub make their way to a tropical island. As those in the sub explore the island, they realize it is full of previously thought-to-be-extinct creatures.
When history's greatest aquatic predator returns, the armada of modern warships sent to destroy it has no chance at all.
When a super cyclone threatens the entire American eastern seaboard, a lone meteorologist and a petroleum engineer must battle the elements to stop the threat.
In the future, glacial melting has covered 98% of earth. Sharks dominate the planet, led by a mutated alpha shark, as human survivors live in terror.
A mission to rescue a marooned base on a desert planet turns deadly when the crew finds themselves hunted and attacked by the planet's apex predators: giant sandworms.
The passengers and crew on a 757 fight to stay alive after they are transported into an air battle between Allied and German forces.
Alexandra D'Artagnan, junior NSA officer, uncovers a plot to assasinate the President of the United States and enlists the help of three infamous international spies to stop the threat.
As scientists study the effects of climate change on marine life under Arctic ice, a new breed of shark breaks through, forcing the scientists to fight back.
Inmates and guards trapped in a maximum security prison are prey to a demonic beast that feeds on human flesh.
Four friends lose consciousness when they are kidnapped by alien creatures. They awaken in a US Government facility for observation. That is when the nightmare begins.
A Horrifying Supernatural Thriller of Faith in the tradition of The Omen and The Devil's Advocate.
A black ops reconnaissance team is sent to investigate the crash of an unidentified aircraft. There, they discover that they are being hunted by an alien expedition to Earth.

What is supposed to be a marriage boot camp on a remote island turns into the ultimate test for survival when a 6-headed shark starts attacking the beach. Trapped with minimal weapons, they discover that no one is safe in the water or on land.
When an ancient warlord summons a mythological beast, a young hero must complete a series of quests to awaken the dragon that will defeat the monster.
